items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: while you were still with Calloway, in 1936, you recorded with Putney Dandridge, right, a small band

ctx.x: Well, either that or they were just sort of giving us a hard time, I don't know. They just started blasting all kinds of distortions with their horns and then we came on and do it and we tore up the theater, man. Tore it up. So that gave us some sort of encouragement. We say well what those guys doing down there. So baby when that show went on and tore the theater up.
Now, when you came back, and then --
well, while you were still with Calloway, in 1936, you recorded with Putney Dandridge, right, a small band --
